attchmntText: Shankar Lal Rampal Dye-Chem Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Shankar Lal Rampal Dye-Chem Limited approved standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board meeting occurred on 11th November 2026. Revenue from operations stood at 16,615.08 lakhs for the quarter and 30,170.46 lakhs for the half year. Profit before tax was 937.64 lakhs for the quarter and 2,168.61 lakhs for the half year. Net profit was 704.30 lakhs for the quarter and 1,622.81 lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share were 1.10 for the quarter and 2.54 for the half year. The company noted dividend distribution status approved on 19th September 2026. Related party transactions were reported, including remuneration to directors and rent paid to relatives. The statutory auditor conducted a limited review of these results.

attchmntText: Shankar Lal Rampal Dye-Chem Limited has informed the Exchange about Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018-Regulation 76
desc: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
